import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile2 = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):
        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p])
                nisa.nc_matmul(dst=tile2, stationary=tile, moving=tile, transpose_moving=True)
                nisa.tensor_copy(dst=tile, src=tile2)
                nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=tile, data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[c, h, w], src=tile)
    return out

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_tiled_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for lhsT and rhs
    sbuf_lhsT = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape, dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_rhs = nl.ndarray(shape=rhs.shape, dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT and rhs from HBM to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_lhsT, src=lhsT)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_rhs, src=rhs)
    
    # Allocate PSUM buffer for the result
    psum = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Tile dimensions
    K = lhsT.shape[0]
    M = lhsT.shape[1]
    N = rhs.shape[1]
    
    # Compute number of tiles along K dimension
    num_tiles = (K + 127) // 128
    
    # Loop over tiles
    for tile_idx in nl.affine_range(num_tiles):
        # Compute tile range along K dimension
        k_start = tile_idx * 128

import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_basic_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape[1:], dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate SBUF for input and output tiles
    sbuf_in = nl.ndarray(shape=(128, 512), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_out = nl.ndarray(shape=(128, 512), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_in, src=lhsT)
    # Copy rhs to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_out, src=rhs)
    
    # Compute matmul

def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D

        for j in nl.affine_range(F2):

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)

    tile = nl.ndarray((128, F2), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

    # Transpose within the tile
    for i in nl.affine_range(F1):
        for j in nl.affine_range(F2):
            tile[i, j] = tile[j, i]
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to output
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=tile)
    
    return out

import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_basic_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape[1:], dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate SBUF for the result
    psum = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape[1:], dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    # Allocate SBUF for the stationary (lhsT) and moving (rhs) operands
    sbuf_stationary = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape, dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_moving = nl.ndarray(shape=rhs.shape, dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_stationary, src=lhsT)
    # Copy rhs to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_moving, src=rhs)
    
    # Perform matrix multiplication
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=sbuf_stationary, moving=sbuf_moving)
    
    # Copy result from PSUM to SBUF
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf_moving, src=psum)
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to shared HBM
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf_moving)
    return out
